proposals.evidence: Turner lists Punjabi sukkā, Jaunsari sūkhō and the Kullu-area śukkhɔ/śūkho forms under the plain śuṣka dry adjective. These unexpanded survey forms retain that regional stem with ordinary agreement vowels and source sibilant notation. l-bearing expanded adjectives and whole verbal phrases are assigned separately or held.
